2026 concept request fee is EUR 255.50.

Opkoopbescherming supports DigiD/eHerkenning and has defined statutory exception grounds.
Current permit applications use Omgevingsloket.
Current 2026 official case evidence confirms dwelling-splitting applications may combine omgevingsplan building activity, technical building activity and/or deviation from the Omgevingsplan.
